notes.title: Going free
notes.content: With the recent Unity Runtime Fee being announced it will affect this title, it will be made free.

notes.title: BIG Performance Increase
notes.content:
Now you can enjoy over 60FPS in game, Lag is history.
Fined tuned game objects for better performance in Mac/Linux/Windows Builds, added graphics/performance options on the in game menu (turn off explodable objects/grass turn off/on/draw distance/quality setting), so you can adjust according to your machine's power.

Check out the Fraps counter on the top right:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/391910/ss_8bd5e59337eee66137c805da99baafe077bba97c.1920x1080.jpg?t=1454149925[/img]
Screenshot taken from machine with Intel Core i5/Nvidea 760 GPU, 8Gb ram

I hope you can enjoy the update.
